cards.front: Complete the rule: Prepare for other drivers’ unexpected actions rather than.
cards.back: Prepare for other drivers’ unexpected actions rather than assuming their intentions, and if a crash cannot be avoided, stay calm and seek the least dangerous outcome.
cards.memory_hook: Expect uncertainty and choose least danger

cards.front: Complete the rule: For the three-second following check, begin counting when.
cards.back: For the three-second following check, begin counting when the leading vehicle passes a fixed landmark and do not reach that landmark before three seconds have elapsed.

cards.back: The three-second gap assumes favorable road and weather conditions; leave more time when either is poor.
cards.memory_hook: Poor conditions require more than basic

cards.front: Complete the rule: If another vehicle follows too closely, change lanes.
cards.back: If another vehicle follows too closely, change lanes or gradually pull off so it can pass.
cards.memory_hook: Let tailgating vehicle pass safely

cards.front: Complete the rule: Adjust speed to weather, traffic and road conditions.
cards.back: Adjust speed to weather, traffic and road conditions while staying at or below the posted maximum; going too quickly or too slowly can be hazardous.
cards.memory_hook: Condition based speed stays below maximum

cards.front: Complete the rule: Speed selection should account for reaction ability, road.
cards.back: Speed selection should account for reaction ability, road condition, tires, brakes, wind and the vehicle’s design and condition.
cards.memory_hook: Driver vehicle and environment affect stopping

cards.front: Complete the rule: Drowsiness impairs safe reactions even without actual sleep.
cards.back: Drowsiness impairs safe reactions even without actual sleep, so start rested and take frequent breaks on long trips.
cards.memory_hook: Rest and breaks help avoid drowsy

cards.front: Complete the rule: Shifting visual focus around the roadway and reading.
cards.back: Shifting visual focus around the roadway and reading signs can help keep the eyes active during driving.
cards.memory_hook: Keep visual attention moving

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid driving in fog when possible; if driving.
cards.back: Avoid driving in fog when possible; if driving is necessary, switch off cruise control, increase the gap and reduce speed.
cards.memory_hook: Fog calls for slower manual speed

cards.front: Complete the rule: In fog use low beams or fog lamps.
cards.back: In fog use low beams or fog lamps, drive within visible stopping space and slow further when seeing another vehicle’s lamps.
cards.memory_hook: Low light and visible stopping space

cards.front: Complete the rule: When fog is too dense, leave the roadway.
cards.back: When fog is too dense, leave the roadway and stop rather than continuing at five to ten miles per hour.
cards.memory_hook: Dense fog calls for stopping off

cards.front: Complete the rule: Signal well before a foggy-weather turn and brake.
cards.back: Signal well before a foggy-weather turn and brake early for a stop to alert following drivers.
cards.memory_hook: Fog requires early communication

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use headlights when rain requires windshield-wiper operation, and.
cards.back: Use headlights when rain requires windshield-wiper operation, and recognize that initial light rain can mix with road contaminants to create a slippery surface.
cards.memory_hook: Rain wipers and headlights go together

cards.front: Complete the rule: In rain, disable cruise control, leave more following.
cards.back: In rain, disable cruise control, leave more following space and take added care while turning, curving or braking.
cards.memory_hook: Rain changes following and control needs

cards.front: Complete the rule: Reduce speed to avoid hydroplaning; if a hydroplaning.
cards.back: Reduce speed to avoid hydroplaning; if a hydroplaning skid cannot be controlled, release the accelerator and allow the skid to run out.
cards.memory_hook: Hydroplaning calls for easing accelerator

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not cross a flooded road or viaduct.
cards.back: Do not cross a flooded road or viaduct because water depth and current cannot be judged reliably; turn around and take another route.
cards.memory_hook: Flooded road requires another route

cards.front: Complete the rule: In strong wind, slow and be ready to.
cards.back: In strong wind, slow and be ready to correct steering when leaving shelter or meeting a truck or bus.
cards.memory_hook: Wind exposure can require steering correction

cards.front: Complete the rule: High winds may accompany rain or sleet, so.
cards.back: High winds may accompany rain or sleet, so plan for wet or slippery pavement as well as the wind itself.
cards.memory_hook: Wind may combine with slippery surfaces

cards.front: Complete the rule: The Illinois toll-road system prohibits.
cards.back: The Illinois toll-road system prohibits hauling house trailers during high winds.
cards.memory_hook: High wind restricts house trailer hauling

cards.front: Complete the rule: In winter slow down, extend following space and.
cards.back: In winter slow down, extend following space and expect surface conditions to differ between sunny, shaded and different roadway areas.
cards.memory_hook: Winter grip can change from place

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not use cruise control on.
cards.back: Do not use cruise control on pavement that is wet, snowy or icy.
cards.memory_hook: Slippery pavement requires cruise control off

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before winter driving, remove snow and ice, clear.
cards.back: Before winter driving, remove snow and ice, clear and defrost all windows, use nonfreezing washer fluid and make headlights and rear lamps visible.
cards.memory_hook: Clear vehicle and windows before travel

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep winter-driving equipment such as lamps, brakes.
cards.back: Keep winter-driving equipment such as lamps, brakes, wipers, defrosters and radiator in working order.
cards.memory_hook: Vehicle maintenance supports winter operation

cards.front: Complete the rule: Snow tires and permitted chains improve traction but.
cards.back: Snow tires and permitted chains improve traction but do not make ordinary driving speeds safe on poor roads.
cards.memory_hook: Traction equipment does not restore normal

cards.front: Complete the rule: Begin braking early and apply gentle, steady braking.
cards.back: Begin braking early and apply gentle, steady braking to judge available traction when nearing a stop.
cards.memory_hook: Early gentle braking checks available traction

cards.front: Complete the rule: Approach bridges, shaded areas, overpasses and turns slowly.
cards.back: Approach bridges, shaded areas, overpasses and turns slowly because they can remain icy after nearby pavement has dried.
cards.memory_hook: Icy spots can persist after other

cards.front: Complete the rule: Carry useful winter supplies such as a blanket.
cards.back: Carry useful winter supplies such as a blanket, food and shovel, and if stranded remain with the vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Prepare supplies and stay with stranded

cards.front: Complete the rule: If possible, keep a stranded vehicle’s.
cards.back: If possible, keep a stranded vehicle’s exhaust outlet clear of snow and debris.
cards.memory_hook: Keep tailpipe unobstructed when possible

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use the expressway acceleration lane to gain appropriate.
cards.back: Use the expressway acceleration lane to gain appropriate speed, signal, find a gap and match traffic before merging when safe.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Check both rear and side mirrors.
cards.back: Check both rear and side mirrors and signal before changing expressway lanes.
cards.memory_hook: Mirror check and signal precede lane

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep ample space behind the vehicle ahead, use.
cards.back: Keep ample space behind the vehicle ahead, use the right lane for slower travel and avoid continuous left-lane driving.
cards.memory_hook: Expressway driving keeps space and proper

cards.front: Complete the rule: If a problem forces a stop, leave the.
cards.back: If a problem forces a stop, leave the expressway roadway, raise the hood and activate hazard lamps, and do not walk along the expressway.
cards.memory_hook: Expressway problem requires off road warning

cards.front: Complete the rule: Exits can be on either side, so select.
cards.back: Exits can be on either side, so select the correct exit lane, signal and reduce speed in the exit speed-change lane.
cards.memory_hook: Plan exit lane before slowing for

cards.front: Complete the rule: After missing an exit, continue to the next.
cards.back: After missing an exit, continue to the next one rather than backing up, which is illegal on an expressway.
cards.memory_hook: Missed exit means next exit

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a lane reduction, merge early if traffic.
cards.back: At a lane reduction, merge early if traffic is light; in dense slow traffic use both lanes to the merge point and alternate joining there.
cards.memory_hook: Congestion changes preferred merge timing

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep headlights clean and correctly aimed, and.
cards.back: Keep headlights clean and correctly aimed, and do not travel beyond the distance they illuminate.
cards.memory_hook: Night speed must stay within lighted

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use headlights from sunset to sunrise and dim.
cards.back: Use headlights from sunset to sunrise and dim high beams five hundred feet before an approaching vehicle or three hundred feet before passing another vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Night lighting includes beam distance rules

cards.front: Complete the rule: Reduce dashboard brightness, use the visor against.
cards.back: Reduce dashboard brightness, use the visor against glare and avoid other interior lights at night.
cards.memory_hook: Limit interior light and glare

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use road-edge and center markings to guide.
cards.back: Use road-edge and center markings to guide nighttime travel, and avoid stopping on the roadway.
cards.memory_hook: Road markings guide night position

cards.front: Complete the rule: Slow and look both ways at every.
cards.back: Slow and look both ways at every rural intersection, including locations without a warning sign.
cards.memory_hook: Unmarked rural junction still needs checking

cards.front: Complete the rule: Slow before entering a curve, avoid abrupt braking.
cards.back: Slow before entering a curve, avoid abrupt braking that may cause a skid and remain on your side of the center line.
cards.memory_hook: Reduce speed before the curve

cards.front: Complete the rule: If a vehicle approaches head-on in your lane.
cards.back: If a vehicle approaches head-on in your lane, slow, move toward the right and sound the horn.
cards.memory_hook: Wrong lane approach calls for rightward

cards.front: Complete the rule: A skid begins when tires lose traction; ease.
cards.back: A skid begins when tires lose traction; ease off the accelerator or brakes, steer in the skid’s direction until grip returns and then straighten.
cards.memory_hook: Ease input and steer with skid

cards.front: Complete the rule: If wheels leave the pavement, hold the wheel.
cards.back: If wheels leave the pavement, hold the wheel firmly, ease off the accelerator, brake gently, check rear traffic and return with gentle steering rather than a sudden correction.
cards.memory_hook: Off pavement recovery uses gradual inputs
